title: A compound path with a hole
concept: Two GeometryPathType contours in one PathGeometry form a shape with a hole.

annotations.note: The first GeometryPathType is the outer contour, wound 0,0 to 240,0 to 240,240 to 0,240.
The second GeometryPathType is the inner contour. It is wound the opposite way so the nonzero winding rule subtracts it, punching the hole.
Each GeometryPathType is recorded as a separate contour boundary (subpath_starts). Drop the second one and the two squares would join into one broken outline instead of a hole.
